reviewer: Codex AI-assisted evidence review; no human product/clinical/safety sign-off.
limits: All 148 cases have an execution attempt/disposition; BLOCKED is not a successful execution.
Backend tool-specific HTTP 503 injection unavailable: browser can simulate only top-level assistant HTTP 503. Kept BLOCKED rather than claim internal tool-fault coverage.
ReadableStream, 429, malformed SSE, empty completion and deterministic Markdown are controlled browser fixtures, not real backend/model responses.
Forced cookie removal represents session loss, not natural token-expiry timing.
390px mobile viewport tested, not physical-device keyboard.
Two concurrent real API conversations per role only; not stress/capacity testing.
No domain action confirmations, real charges, outgoing messages or database edits.
Multi-turn tests use explicit controlled previous messages; not all earlier turns were independently generated in this session.
No numerical accuracy percentage where athlete ground truth is unavailable.
Initial run and all historical failed attempts preserved; latest supplemental attempt determines the catalogue disposition.

findings.title: Events view blocked by backend data failure; earlier URL assertion corrected
findings.detail: Correction: the expected /athlete-registration/events URL was obsolete. open_page correctly maps athlete_events to /athlete-registration/athletes. Routing PASS; the page is blank because athlete data is unavailable and registration/draft returns 503. Labelled browser-only draft-200 control renders setup content. Internal backend cause needs fresh logs; earlier NATS permission finding is not re-proved here.

findings.title: Real Beach Marshal runs terminated with RUN_ERROR
findings.detail: SSE returned code failed and no terminal RUN_FINISHED. Tool results and partial/empty response are preserved. These are actual dev failures, not injected fixtures.

findings.title: Empty and whitespace API requests reach the model
findings.detail: Returns HTTP 200 and a greeting instead of rejecting empty content. This is an API validation gap against the drafted QA expectation.

findings.title: Interrupted or empty SSE can disappear without a useful error
findings.detail: Client recovers its composer but does not clearly tell the user that the answer is incomplete/empty. These are explicitly controlled browser-stream tests.

findings.title: Markdown tables displayed as raw pipes
findings.detail: Safe renderer fixture was readable and inert, but no table was rendered. Product expectation for table support should be confirmed.

findings.title: Live malicious-link prompt returned no answer
findings.detail: No executable navigation/tool call observed; HTTP 200 and terminal finish with empty answer is a response-reliability issue, not a demonstrated security exploit.

findings.title: Athlete data remains unavailable
findings.detail: Existing athlete-data availability issue prevents membership/eligibility factual accuracy checks.

findings.title: Response wording needs review
findings.detail: See exact case notes. Existing acute-anger paddle suggestion and new mixed-language instruction-like fragment require human review.

countingNote: 44 initial cases + 72 additional live API cases + 30 UI cases + 2 concurrency cases = 148 unique cases. Supplemental attempts do not increase unique case count.
